prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Couch Has Notes, Freud and psychoanalysis. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Burgundy, walnut, brass, muted cream and a small oriental-patterned textile accent. Row-major cast:
1. Male-read wry historical analyst. short gray pointed beard, round spectacles, compact dark waistcoat, small notebook at flank. broad pear, one lid raised, tight amused smile.
2. Female-read eager free associator. short ribbon of three tactile pictogram beads, a key, an apple and a bell. tall upright comma, wide curious eyes, mouth half open.
3. Male-read embarrassed verbal slip. two mismatched speech-shaped clay tokens held against chest, blank surfaces. squashed block blob, caught mid-gasp with off-axis pupils.
4. Female-read skeptical analysand. small upholstered chaise cushion with a folded rug corner, held in hand. lean reverse comma, side-eye and taut crooked lip.
5. Male-read defensive intellectualizer. thick hardcover held like a miniature shield. round squat splat, raised eyebrows and pressed lips.
6. Male-read sleepy keeper of dreams. small bedside notebook and old brass pencil. wide droop, heavy lids and faint closed smile.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.
